## Why This Is Asked

## Code Example

```javascript
// Example PII redaction utility (Node.js)
function redactPII(text) {
  return text
    .replace(/[a-zA-Z0-9._%+-]+@[a-z0-9.-]+\\.[a-z]{2,}/gi, "[REDACTED_EMAIL]")
    .replace(/\\b\\d{10}\\b/g, "[REDACTED_PHONE]");
}
```
